Elon: FSD will soon remember parking preferences per location.

Safety critical disengagements are mostly things of the past; most disengagements now happen due to parking preferences/distance from destination.


Elon Musk (@elonmusk)

Upcoming releases of FSD will remember your parking preferences, so that the car goes to the right location at your home, office, school drop off, etc.

Destination parking is by far the biggest reason people now intervene with FSD. Critical safety interventions are extremely rare.



— https://nitter.net/elonmusk/status/2067377176287318326#m
